key: Name's Fern.
en: Name's Fern.
ja: 名前はファーンだ。

key: I'm the cool cat, and the top dog.
en: I'm the cool cat, and the top dog.
ja: クールな野郎で、トップの座にいる男だぜ。

key: Got it memorized?
en: Got it memorized?
ja: 覚えたか?

key: I don't appreciate you interfering with my business.
en: I don't appreciate you interfering with my business.
ja: オレの仕事に首突っ込むのは、感心しねえな。

key: You look utterly clueless, so I'll explain.
en: You look utterly clueless, so I'll explain.
ja: 何も分かってなさそうだから、説明してやるよ。

key: As the one sitting at the top of the social hierarchy, it's my responsibility to make a difference.
en: As the one sitting at the top of the social hierarchy, it's my responsibility to make a difference.
ja: 社会的ヒエラルキーの頂点に立つ者として、世の中を変えるのはオレの責任だ。

en: Clean up others' messes,
ja: 他人の尻拭いをして、

en: Give people a reason to smile.
ja: みんなが笑える理由を作ってやる。

key: You get it?
en: You get it?
ja: 分かるか?

key: So how am I supposed to do that if some lowlife loser like you comes along bumbling into my way and jacks everything up?!
en: So how am I supposed to do that if some lowlife loser like you comes along bumbling into my way and jacks everything up?!
ja: なのに、お前みたいな底辺のクズがドタバタとオレの邪魔をして、全部台無しにしたらどうすりゃいいんだよ?!

key: That was the culprit responsible for the accident at Grandview Station-- no mistake!
en: That was the culprit responsible for the accident at Grandview Station-- no mistake!
ja: あいつがグランドビュー駅の事件の犯人だ――間違いねえ!

key: And thanks to you interrupting, he got away!
en: And thanks to you interrupting, he got away!
ja: それがお前が邪魔したせいで、逃げられちまったんだよ!

key: Get the picture now?
en: Get the picture now?
ja: これで分かったか?

key: Cuz I don't think you do.
en: Cuz I don't think you do.
ja: どうせ分かってねえだろうけどな。

key: Not well enough.
en: Not well enough.
ja: 十分にはな。

key: Get ready to take notes,
en: Get ready to take notes,
ja: メモの準備でもしとけ、

key: Cuz you're about to get schooled.
en: Cuz you're about to get schooled.
ja: 今からお勉強させてやるからよ。

key: Hah! Way to get lucky.
en: Hah! Way to get lucky.
ja: はっ! 運がよかっただけだろ

key: FERN: Tch. Whatever.
en: FERN: Tch. Whatever.
ja: ファーン: チッ。もういいわ。

key: I don't have time for this.
en: I don't have time for this.
ja: こんなことに構ってる時間はねえ。

key: I've gotta go find that guy and cover for your mistake now.
en: I've gotta go find that guy and cover for your mistake now.
ja: あいつを探して、お前のミスの尻拭いをしに行かねえと。

key: ???: No need.
en: ???: No need.
ja: ???: その必要はない。

key: FERN: Excuse me?
en: FERN: Excuse me?
ja: ファーン: あ?

key: ???: While you two were busy horsing around, I already caught the perp.
en: ???: While you two were busy horsing around, I already caught the perp.
ja: ???: お前ら二人がじゃれ合ってる間に、もう犯人は捕まえておいた。

key: ???: While you ladies were busy with your little cat fight, I already caught the perp.
en: ???: While you ladies were busy with your little cat fight, I already caught the perp.
ja: ???: お前らお嬢さん方が、ちょっとした女けんかに忙しくしてる間に、もう犯人は捕まえておいた。

key: Reborn City Official Inspector, at your service.
en: Reborn City Official Inspector, at your service.
ja: リボーンシティ公式監察官だ、お見知りおきを。

key: You all can move along now.
en: You all can move along now.
ja: もう解散していいぞ。

key: FERN: What, that's it? Just "move along?"
en: FERN: What, that's it? Just "move along?"
ja: ファーン: は? それだけかよ? 「解散」だと?

key: You gonna sweep this under the rug like the rest of the shady business that's been going down here?
en: You gonna sweep this under the rug like the rest of the shady business that's been going down here?
ja: この辺で起きてる他のうさん臭い事件と同じように、これももみ消すつもりか?

key: Everyone knows the police don't do a damn thing.
en: Everyone knows the police don't do a damn thing.
ja: 警察が何もしねえのは、みんな知ってることだぜ。

key: INSPECTOR: Tsk, tsk, tsk...
en: INSPECTOR: Tsk, tsk, tsk...
ja: 監察官: チッチッチッ……

key: FERN: You got somethin' to say?
en: FERN: You got somethin' to say?
ja: ファーン: 何か言いたいことでもあんのか?

key: INSPECTOR: Children should listen before they speak.
en: INSPECTOR: Children should listen before they speak.
ja: 監察官: 子供は話す前に、まず聞くものだ。

key: Torkoal and I already took the liberty of having a little chat with our perp.
en: Torkoal and I already took the liberty of having a little chat with our perp.
ja: コータスと私で、すでに犯人と少々お話をさせてもらった。

key: We've learned quite a few things that will be of use to the main force.
en: We've learned quite a few things that will be of use to the main force.
ja: 本隊の役に立つ情報を、いくつも聞き出せたぞ。

key: The culprit's in custody, and we'll be arranging a raid on their little gang's hideout just as soon as the paperwork clears.
en: The culprit's in custody, and we'll be arranging a raid on their little gang's hideout just as soon as the paperwork clears.
ja: 犯人はすでに拘束済みだ。書類が通り次第、あの小さなギャングのアジトへの強制捜査を手配する。

key: I'm afraid there's no room for kids like you to be playing vigilante.
en: I'm afraid there's no room for kids like you to be playing vigilante.
ja: 残念ながら、お前たちのような子供が自警団気取りをする余地はない。

key: You should go home before someone gets hurt.
en: You should go home before someone gets hurt.
ja: 誰かが怪我をする前に、家に帰りなさい。

key: FERN: So they're not working alone? What's this hideout?
en: FERN: So they're not working alone? What's this hideout?
ja: ファーン: つまり単独犯じゃねえってことか? そのアジトってのは何だ?

key: INSPECTOR: Classified information, pipsqueak.
en: INSPECTOR: Classified information, pipsqueak.
ja: 監察官: 機密情報だ、坊や。

key: Obviously I'm not going to leak information on a nearby criminal den to whelps like you.
en: Obviously I'm not going to leak information on a nearby criminal den to whelps like you.
ja: お前らみたいなひよっこに、近くの犯罪の巣窟の情報を漏らすわけがなかろう。

key: Ask your mommy once it's on the news.
en: Ask your mommy once it's on the news.
ja: ニュースになったら、母ちゃんにでも聞け。

key: FERN: ...Dumbass.
en: FERN: ...Dumbass.
ja: ファーン: ……間抜けが。

key: He just said it's nearby.
en: He just said it's nearby.
ja: 「近く」って言っちまってるじゃねえか。

key: And I know for a fact I heard that shady guy mention something about a facility.
en: And I know for a fact I heard that shady guy mention something about a facility.
ja: それに、あの怪しい奴が施設がどうとか言ってたのを、確かに聞いたぜ。

key: If it's not this building, I bet it's the other one.
en: If it's not this building, I bet it's the other one.
ja: ここの建物じゃねえなら、もう一つの方だろうな。

key: Smaller than this, and fenced off.
en: Smaller than this, and fenced off.
ja: ここより小さくて、フェンスで囲われてる場所だ。

key: You probably passed it on the way here.
en: You probably passed it on the way here.
ja: ここに来る途中で、通り過ぎたはずだぜ。

key: Bet you that's the place.
en: Bet you that's the place.
ja: あそこで決まりだな。

key: FERN: So here's the plan.
en: FERN: So here's the plan.
ja: ファーン: というわけで、計画はこうだ。

key: Obviously that "paperwork" is gonna take way too long.
en: Obviously that "paperwork" is gonna take way too long.
ja: どう考えても、あの「書類」とやらは時間がかかりすぎる。

key: So I'm gonna go do something about it, and you're gonna help.
en: So I'm gonna go do something about it, and you're gonna help.
ja: だからオレが片付けに行く、お前も手伝えよ。

key: It's your fault I didn't get that information from the guy directly.
en: It's your fault I didn't get that information from the guy directly.
ja: あいつから直接情報を聞き出せなかったのは、お前のせいだからな。

key: The least you can do is fix your mistake.
en: The least you can do is fix your mistake.
ja: せめて自分のミスくらい、自分で片付けろ。

key: Got it?
en: Got it?
ja: 分かったか?

key: I'll meet you there.
en: I'll meet you there.
ja: そこで落ち合おうぜ。

key: Try not to be too late.
en: Try not to be too late.
ja: あんまり遅れんなよ。

key: AMARIA: Great, you're here!
en: AMARIA: Great, you're here!
ja: アマリア: よかった、来たね!

key: I don't know how much resistance we should expect in there...
en: I don't know how much resistance we should expect in there...
ja: 中でどれくらいの抵抗があるか分からないけど……

key: Are you ready to do this?
en: Are you ready to do this?
ja: 準備はいい?

key: AMARIA: All right, then we just need to figure out the way in!
en: AMARIA: All right, then we just need to figure out the way in!
ja: アマリア: よし、それじゃ入り方を考えないとね!

key: Obviously, the door is locked so...
en: Obviously, the door is locked so...
ja: どう見てもドアには鍵がかかってるし……

key: ACE: Don't you even worry about that, little darlings~
en: ACE: Don't you even worry about that, little darlings~
ja: エース: そんなこと、心配することはないさ、小さなお嬢さんたち~

key: AMARIA: You know how to get in?
en: AMARIA: You know how to get in?
ja: アマリア: 入り方、知ってるの?

key: ACE: But of course!
en: ACE: But of course!
ja: エース: 当然だとも!

key: What kind of magician would I be if I didn't know my way around the backstage?
en: What kind of magician would I be if I didn't know my way around the backstage?
ja: 舞台裏の勝手を知らぬ手品師など、どこにいるというのだね?

en: There's a very simple trick, you see:

en: All you have to do,
ja: 君がすべきことは、

en: ...Is go through the door!
ja: ……このドアを通り抜けることだけだ!

key: AMARIA: But... it's locked.
en: AMARIA: But... it's locked.
ja: アマリア: でも……鍵がかかってるよ。

key: We just said that.
en: We just said that.
ja: 今、それを言ったじゃない。

key: ACE: Oh, it's locked.
en: ACE: Oh, it's locked.
ja: エース: ああ、鍵がかかっているのか。

key: Well, never you mind then--
en: Well, never you mind then--
ja: ならば、忘れてくれたまえ――

key: Clearly I am simply mistaken--
en: Clearly I am simply mistaken--
ja: 明らかに、私が単に間違えていたのだ――

key: A fool--
en: A fool--
ja: 愚か者――

key: A nitwit--
en: A nitwit--
ja: まぬけ者――

key: An utter dunderhead!
en: An utter dunderhead!
ja: 全くの大バカ者だ!

key: Unless!
en: Unless!
ja: だが、もし!

key: What if!
en: What if!
ja: もしも!

key: There was--
en: There was--
ja: あったとしたら――

key: ...A second door?!
en: ...A second door?!
ja: ……二つ目のドアが!?

key: AMARIA: Is there, really?
en: AMARIA: Is there, really?
ja: アマリア: あるの、本当に?

key: ACE: Ah, but what good are words to explain the designs,
en: ACE: Ah, but what good are words to explain the designs,
ja: エース: ああ、しかし、その仕掛けを言葉で説明したところで、何になろうか、

ja: まだ見ぬものは、自分の目で見られるというのに?

key: AMARIA: Oh! How did--
en: AMARIA: Oh! How did--
ja: アマリア: あっ! どうやって――

key: ACE: Ah, ah, ah~
en: ACE: Ah, ah, ah~
ja: エース: あぁ、あぁ、あぁ~

key: Now I KNOW a lady as smart as you isn't about to ask something as silly as "How did you do that?"
en: Now I KNOW a lady as smart as you isn't about to ask something as silly as "How did you do that?"
ja: 君ほど賢いご婦人が、「どうやったの?」などという愚問を口にするはずがないと、私は分かっているのだよ。

key: You already know I'll never tell.
en: You already know I'll never tell.
ja: 私が決して明かさぬことは、君も知っているだろう。

key: Now, press ahead!

ja: さあ、先に進みたまえ!

key: I'll be along to assist just as soon as I take care of your companion~
en: I'll be along to assist just as soon as I take care of your companion~

key: AMARIA: ...What a strange character.
